title: MZ Making one event move to another event by name specifically

posts.author: wormonastringMZ
posts.body:
Hi! I was wondering if there was any kind of plugin based on the title above. If it works with VisuStella's furniture system plugin, I would be happiest!
Basically, I'm working on a project in which an NPC would be spawned from one map to another. This map would be one where custom furniture can be placed anywhere, and each furniture piece is an event using VisuStella's plugin. Once spawned, the NPC would walk over to this furniture event and interact with it.
I've found other movement plugins, but I've yet to see one which does it by the event's name. This makes it difficult, as I don't know how I'd be able to make the NPCs move to events that have an unpredictable ID.
Thank you so much for looking into this! If this is the wrong category, please let me know as I am unfamiliar with this site.
I will also use a plugin for MV, but prefer MZ as it is the one I am making my project on.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
This is doable by script, the problem is more than one event can have the same name.
If you have three "chair"s in the map, which one would you go to?

I also had this concern, though I figured this could potentially be something that's checked through eventing.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body:
Something like
Code:
for (var i = 0; i < $gameMap.events().length; i++){ if ($gameMap.events()[i].event().name == "Chair"){ $gameVariables.setValue(20, $gameMap.events()[i]._id); break;} }
Loop through every event on the map, if the event is named "Chair", set Game Variable 20 to its id, stop at the first result.
Then you would just use your movement script to move to event ID ($gameVariables.value(20))

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
To find the first event ID on a map with a given name, you can set a variable to
Code:
$gameMap.events().find(event => event.event().name == "chair").eventId()

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
kurokami said:
Thank you! I'm a beginner at this, would you put this before the moving command?
Click to expand...
You do that in the script field for Control Variables to put the event ID in it.
You would have to have some way to be able to use that ID in a move route - some movement plugin or something. That's not built into RPG Maker.
I suppose you could use Control Variables math to calculate the X and Y differences between your current position and the chair event, then use Loop event commands with moving a single space at a time to get there, but that wouldn't account for any other furniture in the way.

posts.author: Slaughty
posts.body: The furniture system has a Javascript on place notetag where you could store the event x and y coordinates to variables and then use the event and movement core plugin command move the event to those x y coordinates
